guardrails: Write only under hgm-infra/** for this step.
Do not modify application/library code (pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, examples/**).
Do not weaken any existing rubric requirements, thresholds, or verifier behavior (no dilution).
Keep the MAI-2 check deterministic and fail-closed if the maintainability roadmap is missing, incomplete, or mismatched to the active rubric version.
prompt.prompt_text:
You are executing Lift’s Hypergenium roadmap step M3+ (Maintainability), focusing ONLY on rubric item MAI-2: “Maintainability roadmap current”.

Current state (source of truth)
- Rubric report: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows MAI-2 = BLOCKED with message “Verifier command not configured”.
- Evidence placeholder: hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-2-output.log contains only a TODO string.
- Rubric definition: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md lists MAI-2 verification as TODO (BLOCKED).

Goal
- Turn MAI-2 from BLOCKED → PASS by:
  1) Creating an explicit, versioned maintainability roadmap document under hgm-infra/planning/
  2) Wiring a deterministic check into the single verifier entrypoint (hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh)
  3) Updating planning docs so they match the verifier (anti-drift)
- Keep this step governance-only: do NOT change application/library code outside hgm-infra/**.

Strict scope / change boundaries
- Allowed changes:
  - You MAY create/update files under:
    - hgm-infra/planning/**
    - hgm-infra/verifiers/**
    - hgm-infra/evidence/** (notes/evidence outputs produced by verifier)
- Prohibited changes:
  - Do NOT modify production or example code under: pkg/**, cmd/**, internal/**, examples/**, scripts/**
  - Do NOT weaken any existing rubric requirements, thresholds, or verifier checks (no dilution).
  - Do NOT write outside hgm-infra/** for this step.

Tasks (do in order)

1) Create the maintainability roadmap planning artifact
Create a new file:
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-maintainability-roadmap.md

Content requirements (keep it concise but concrete and measurable):
- Title includes project + rubric version, e.g. “Lift: Maintainability Roadmap (Rubric v0.1.0)”.
- Must explicitly mention the active rubric version string in-text: “Rubric v0.1.0”.
- Must include these sections (exact headings or clearly identifiable equivalents):
  - “Guardrails” (what is currently enforced / why)
  - “Milestones” (future work, each with measurable acceptance criteria)
  - “Progress log” (may be empty initially)
- Must include (at minimum) the following roadmap points:
  - MAI-1 (file budget) as an already-enforced guardrail
  - MAI-3 (canonical semantics / duplication control) as a planned or upcoming workstream

2) Wire MAI-2 into the deterministic verifier (fail-closed)
Edit:
- hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

Add a repo-specific check function, for example:
- maintainability_roadmap_check()

The check must be deterministic and fail-closed:
- If hgm-infra/planning/lift-maintainability-roadmap.md is missing → exit non-zero (FAIL).
- If it does not contain “Rubric v0.1.0” → exit non-zero (FAIL).
- If it does not contain required section markers (“Guardrails”, “Milestones”, “Progress log”) → exit non-zero (FAIL).
- On success, print a short success line (e.g., “Maintainability roadmap OK”).

Then replace the existing MAI-2 TODO run_check with the real check:
- Change from:
  - run_check "MAI-2" "Maintainability" "TODO: ..."
- To:
  - run_check "MAI-2" "Maintainability" "maintainability_roadmap_check"

Do not change unrelated checks.

3) Update planning docs to remove MAI-2 “TODO” verifier text (anti-drift alignment)
Update:
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
  - In the Maintainability (MAI) table, update MAI-2 “How to verify” to reference the deterministic verifier entrypoint, e.g.:
    - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh (MAI-2)
  - Do NOT change points/requirements, only replace the TODO verifier text.

Update:
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
  - In the Rubric-to-evidence map row for MAI-2, replace TODO refresh instructions with:
    - bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

Update:
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
  - Add the new document (lift-maintainability-roadmap.md) to the “Workstream tracking docs” list.
  - After verification (step 4), update the rubric-to-milestone mapping row for MAI-2 to PASS.
  - Add a short Progress log entry describing what changed and pointing to evidence paths.

4) Refresh evidence (must be regenerated, not hand-waved)
Run:
- bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh

Confirm outcomes:
- hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-2-output.log is no longer a TODO message; it should contain the output of maintainability_roadmap_check.
- hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json shows MAI-2 = PASS.

5) Record progress (human note under evidence)
Create:
- hgm-infra/evidence/M3+-MAI-2-notes.md
Include:
- Date
- Summary of changes (new planning doc + verifier wiring)
- Commands run
- Evidence pointers:
  - hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-2-output.log
  - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json

Acceptance criteria
- MAI-2 is PASS in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json.
- The MAI-2 verifier is deterministic and fails closed if the roadmap doc is missing or mismatched to rubric version.
- No code changes outside hgm-infra/**.

Deliverables
- New: hgm-infra/planning/lift-maintainability-roadmap.md
- Updated: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Updated: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
- Updated: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Updated: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
- New: hgm-infra/evidence/M3+-MAI-2-notes.md
- Refreshed evidence: hgm-infra/evidence/MAI-2-output.log and hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
prompt.step_description: Unblock MAI-2 by creating a versioned maintainability roadmap planning artifact and wiring a deterministic verifier check for it (governance-only; no application code changes).
